subject: Private/public redundancy with restore proof and replaceable open-source donor roles rather than tool-shaped architecture
contradictions: restic/rclone candidates overlap current encrypted-staging doctrine; Syncthing/NATS/Headscale/DuckDB remain donors only and are not integrated or required.
tests: prove one independent private replica can restore an exact object not from the primary writer
prove public mirror projection contains no private payload by default
treat donor implementations as replaceable adapters behind capability contracts
expected_benefit: Move redundancy from copy-count rhetoric toward independently restorable custody while avoiding permanent dependence on any listed donor tool.
risks: backup may be claimed without restore proof
tool choice may become accidental architecture
public mirror may be mistaken for private backup
wake_conditions: private off-machine custody route is available
restore canary can run without secret exposure
a donor capability gap requires implementation comparison
